8 Amazon Hacks that I actually use.

1. Launch Group - Get potential customers into a Facebook group. Get them excited about you and your product before you launch your product on Amazon. 
2. External Traffic - Use Instagram, SEO, Paid advertisement and all social media to drive traffic to your product page and Amazon will reward you for that by promoting your product. 
3. Create an Email list - This will allow you to get people excited about your product. 
4. Basics - A high-quality main image, a keyword rich title, high-quality bullet points that show the benefits of the product, a description that highlights why your product is amazing and all the other images. 
5. Question and Answer - Use this section of your Amazon's product page to make your customers' confident that your product is the right one for them. 
6. Coupon Stack - Give your customers a discount for buying more than one item. 
7. Ads - You can use Amazon's paid Ads to rank #1 for any keywords you want. 
8. Make Unique Product - Do not sell the same junk as everybody else.
